end.summary: Defined food miles as the distance food travels from its source to the eater, often measured in kilometres.
end.parentNote: Rohan practised tracing food from a farm to a shop and linking longer journeys with more petrol use. They gave examples involving local food, seasonal availability, and food transported from far away. Their final definition was partly stated, but the teach-back was not yet passed; at home, ask them to explain food miles using one local and one distant food example.
